title: Paul McCartney live: MGM Grand Garden Arena, Las Vegas | 2002
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA, on 6 April 2002.

It was the fourth date of the Driving World Tour, which lasted for 58 dates across four countries between April and November 2002, and the second of two consecutive nights in Las Vegas.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

The Driving World Tour returned to the MGM Grand Garden Arena on 26 October 2002. McCartney played there again during the US Tour on 25 and 26 November 2005. He performed a private concert there for delegates attending the Hewlett-Packard Discover Americas trade conference on 9 June 2011, and the following night played there again for the Up And Coming Tour. On 21 September 2013 he performed there at the iHeartRadio Music Festival.
